explanation: It is the traditional ensemble music of Java and Bali. Claude Debussy heard a Javanese gamelan at the 1889 Paris World's Fair, and its sound shaped his piano writing.

claims.text: Gamelan is a traditional ensemble music of Indonesia, played largely on tuned gongs and metallophones.
Gamelan is not a tradition of Thailand, the Philippines or Japan.
Java and Bali have the main gamelan traditions.
Claude Debussy heard a Javanese gamelan at the 1889 Exposition Universelle in Paris.
The sound of the gamelan influenced Debussy's piano music.
